title: Chapter 498
paragraphs: Chapter 498
Episode 138. Tower Keeper of Baekya (4)
No, why did it fall now? Jin was almost distracted by the key as well.
It felt like his heart was sinking.
If the spaceship blueprint had already been stolen by someone, Rune Kendel's efforts would have been in vain.
'Could it be Joshua? No, considering the timing and the situation, it can't be. He seemed to have made up his mind when he handed over the key.'
Then, the remaining suspect was Kinzelo.
'The reason only the four members of the Spectral Squad remained in this 2nd Magic Tower in the first place was because the rest of the troops went out to track down the stolen blueprint!'
For now, he had no choice but to make that assumption.
However, Hedo's purpose was still unclear.
- If you've taken anything from this place, leave it behind. Then I'll spare your life for now.
Logically, that's not something you would say to an enemy.
Thump, thump, roll, whoosh-!
The fallen key was swept away by the heat wave of Upwha and disappeared into the flames. Hedo let out a sigh as if it was ridiculous, and it was the worst moment to be misunderstood.
Hedo couldn't quickly understand the situation either.
He also had the same key given to him by Sandra.
'Why does Jin Rune Kendel have the vault key?'
As far as Hedo knew, there was only one key. At least until now.
"12th generation, I don't know where you got that key from. But what I just said still stands."
As if he didn't want to think too much, Hedo spoke with a furrowed brow.
Whether the key was duplicated, or he didn't know there was a spare, or Rune Kendel had stolen it, or anything else. It was his judgment that he only needed to retrieve the blueprint and let Jin go.
Sandra Jifle was waiting for Jin at the top of the tower, dressed in her finest.

There was even a table set for a private dinner between them (which Hedo had prepared himself before coming to find his companions). To endure her waiting and excitement, Sandra was sipping an aperitif while watching the spectacular view of the Sota Desert's secret drying facility exploding.
As he thought of her troubled appearance, the veins in his forehead thickened.
- Miss Sandra.
- Ah, why!
- You should report.
- What report?
- That Jin Rune Kendel has come to the drying facility. You should report it to the Duke, as you are on duty now.
- Hedo, then my husband will die. Or he will no longer be Jin.
- Maybe so. Well, considering the survival skills the 12th generation has shown so far, you never know.
So don't ever spout such nonsense again.
Even thinking about that conversation, it would be better to save Jin and let him go.
Although he had set the table to calm Sandra down for now, having dinner would be too much.
"I don't have the blueprint."
"Didn't you just drop the key? Don't make foolish judgments. I don't want to kill you unless I have to."
"Thanks for the heartwarming words. But what can I do if I don't have it? And it seems you've forgotten."
We're still fighting, tower keeper.
As Jin spoke, the flames intensified. The fires clinging to Hedo's body exploded, and the spreading flames began to engulf him.
The secret technique of the old Rune Kendel's ten knights, the strongest among them, was Sara Rune Kendel's.
Although it was still incomplete, it was not something to be taken lightly.
For the first time.
Hedo let out a short groan and stepped back. The unleashed flames had far more power than he had expected.
'From the beginning, it was the right choice to block or dodge this sword. Was I too careless, as Jin Rune Kendel said? This might get a bit tiring...'
He could feel the heat of the flames penetrating his protective barrier and flesh, infiltrating his internal organs.
It had been a long time since he felt such pain. It seemed that it would take some time for the fierce heat to subside even if he expelled his energy.
The problem was that the flames weren't the only issue.
The other Rune Kendels had been waiting for just such a moment.
"Well done, youngest!"
The first to follow up was Diphus.
His second meteor shower poured down behind Hedo, who had stepped back.

But that wasn't all. The destructive power of the meteor shower was undoubtedly one of the best among the final techniques, but it seemed that it wouldn't be enough to deal a proper blow to the giant.
Diphus prepared another, more refined sword.
Rune Kendel's 5th secret technique
Lightspeed Thrust
A sword polished several times with Meri, transcending limits.
Flash!
The dazzling flash struck Hedo's back before the meteor shower. It was a lightspeed thrust, one step ahead of Meri, reaching its extreme.
Hedo couldn't dodge Diphus's sword.
The lightspeed thrust, distorting space as it advanced, pierced the mountain-like back of Hedo.
Hedo was pushed forward, vomiting blood, and while the lightspeed thrust couldn't fully penetrate his enormous body, the shockwave that spread forward shook the entire tower.
Such flashes of light were connected in six lines.
There was no choice but to be caught in the counterflow, but there was no other way. Diphus recognized this as the last chance to turn the tide.
After finishing his attack, Diphus spat out a dark blood clot.
Aaargh-!
Hedo screamed.
It was impossible to tell if it was a scream or a roar. The only certain thing was that even after being hit by the meteor shower and six lightspeed thrusts, he showed no signs of falling.
Even in the midst of all that, Hedo was still swinging his longsword to keep Jin in check and was aware of the other swords that would come next.
'Monster...!'
Next were Joshua and Jane.
The six lightspeed thrusts had not left Hedo unscathed. Jane approached Hedo, mixed in with the meteor shower, and stabbed her sword into the wound caused by the lightspeed thrusts.
A single knuckle.
Although it was just that much, Jane's blade clearly dug into Hedo's wound. Blood splattered, and flesh was cut.
"Bastard!"

Hedo glared at Jane and pushed her away, scattering sword energy. While Hedo was only lightly stabbed about five times, Jane was thrown against the wall, her wrist shattered, and she suffered significant internal injuries.
Still, Jane was not disappointed. Blood welled up from deep within her chest, but she had finally struck a blow and created an opening against the monster. A very small opening.
Joshua's sword was piercing that gap.
"Kaaaaa!"
A desperate, venomous scream, with all his might.

No one called Joshua the strongest knight by sheer force alone. He was always overshadowed by the giant shadow of Luna, and among the siblings, public opinion dominated that he became the next head of the family due to his cunning strategies and Rosa's full support rather than his swordsmanship.
That wasn't a wrong story.
However, he was undoubtedly the second knight of Rune Kendel. He was also the one who challenged and lost to the strongest knight of Rune Kendel more than anyone else.
In other words, Joshua had potential. He gained enlightenment through numerous defeats and contempt, and learned how to incorporate it into his sword.
This was the result.
The black sword Kainer was dyed with dark energy.
It had a similar shape to aura but was not as deep, and it was a peculiar energy with the glow of aura.
Although it wasn't a unique domain like Luna's spiritual sword, it was a special-colored sword energy that had to be reached in order to obtain the Five Elements as a Rune Kendel.
Rune Kendel's 4th secret technique
Black Cross
Joshua's sword drew a cross.
The perfectly straight black shining sword energy burst forth, riding on a flawless cross.
The intersection of the sword energies was aimed at Hedo's shoulder.
Originally, it targeted the middle of his face, but it was deflected because he reacted. However, the Black Cross was not a sword that lost much of its power even if it was slightly off.
The Black Cross, as its name suggests, was not a sword energy made up of two lines.
As soon as the secret technique began, Joshua's black sword energy drew a huge circle, spreading out and aiming at Hedo from all directions.
Swoosh, hiss-!
As if snipers who had finished surrounding their target were firing in unison, numerous black sword energies in the shape of a cross gathered at the intersection point and began to cut into Hedo.
If Joshua had unleashed the Black Cross alone, it would have been difficult to deal significant damage.
Indeed, the previous attacks by the Runecandel swords were not in vain.
Finally, Hedo seemed to be writhing in pain. Although faint, he let out a moan instead of a roar, and failed to repel at least 10% of the numerous black sword energies of the Black Cross.
If it hadn't been a warrior like Hedo, that 10% alone would have been enough to tear their body into hundreds of pieces.
"Ugh, ugh!"
Joshua crouched down and gasped for breath.
'Damn it, was it not enough...?'
Hedo, who began to ward off the Black Cross, seemed to regain his strength with every passing second.
He was injured, but it wasn't a fatal wound.
"Like the Black Dragon said, Murakan is Murakan, but Runecandel is still Runecandel. I was a little surprised."
Spitting out blood, Hedo wiped his face and spoke.
[I'm getting tired of you.]
Murakan absorbed the remaining flames of the wildfire in a whirlwind.

By then, the spirits were barely standing, completely exhausted. Throughout the fierce battle with the wildfire and the secret techniques, they had only managed to maintain a barrier and had exhausted all their energy.
[Hey, kid. It's not going to work. There's no answer. Take care of the others and run. I'll deal with him and somehow follow you.]
"It doesn't seem like a bad plan, but unfortunately, I can't help you, Lord Murakan. If Runecandel refuses to return what they stole, I have no choice but to go back on my word."
[What?]
"I mean, I will request support from the main family. I don't want to waste any more strength. My patience is running thin."

[You don't look like the type to say one thing and do another. Are you going to act all high and mighty? You don't want to waste any more strength because the battle is getting burdensome. You got hit more than you expected.]
"Think what you will. But even if you do, it won't make the situation any better. The Black Dragon should know that too."
[Heh, and what's this nonsense about us stealing the blueprint? We haven't even cracked the vault here, huh? You're just trying to pin this on us.]
Murakan and the other Runecandel members hadn't seen the key burn in the wildfire, and they hadn't heard the conversation between Jin and Hedo at that time.
Hedo decided to talk to Jin instead of Murakan.

"You have a knack for complicating simple problems, 12th generation. If you keep insisting, you'll regret it. But before that, let me make one thing clear: I've been as considerate to you as possible..."
At that moment.
Hedo suddenly turned around and swung his long sword Veil behind him. He had sensed that someone had broken through his senses and approached him at close range.
It was an assassination attempt.
And there were only a handful of people in the world who could attempt an assassination against Hedo... One of them was a legendary assassin born in the Garden of Swords.
It was Yona.
